entities.summary: Logan Wilson is an American former professional football player who was a linebacker for six seasons in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Wyoming Cowboys and was selected by the Cincinnati Bengals in the third round of the 2020 NFL draft. He also played for the Dallas Cowboys.
